table.name: TLGNC_SHIPTO_SAREA_RESTR
table.description: Represents the product restrictions for a given Shipto and Sales Area. It contains the main data of the Dispokarte. Restrictions are depending a lot on the SAP pricing conditions (material and transport cond.)

column.name: SHIPTO_SAREA_ID
column.description: FK tlgnc_shipto_sarea. The related Shipto/Sales Area tuple.

column.name: ENABLED_FLAG
column.description: Whether the restriction is enabled (=checkbox set in the user interface)

column.name: AVAILABLE_IN_CUST_WEB_FLAG
column.description: 1=material restriction allowed/visible in customer web application for order creation by a web-customer. 0=not visible in customer web application. By setting these flags right it can be distinguished between dispocard defaults relevant for customer / only for call center.

column.name: AVAILABLE_IN_PICKUP_APP_FLAG
column.description: 1=material restriction allowed/visible in pickup/terminal application for order creation by a pickup-customer. 0=not visible in pickup/terminal application. By setting these flags right it can be distinguished between dispocard defaults relevant for pickup / only for call center.

column.name: SAP_MATERIAL_ID
column.description: FK tlgns_sap_material. The related material. Until Logon 2.0 ne record with material 'null' was allowed, this is the * restriction. DB field was therefore nullable, but from Logon 2.0 it is not nullable.

column.name: MIX_DESIGN_ID
column.description: FK to tlgnc_fireq_material_mixdesign. Mix design id of this restriction. Mix design can only be specified for aggregate material + production plant combination. Mix design business term: Recipe/Formula of the material composition of the aggregates material.

column.name: PRODUCTION_PLANT_CD
column.description: FK tlgnr_plant_cd. The production plant where the material is produced.

column.name: SHIPTO_SILO_ID
column.description: FK tlgnc_shipto_silo. The related silo. If set (default silo for this material) the material should match shipto_silo.sap_material_id, but this could change over time, when materials in silos change!

column.name: SHIPPINGPOINT_ID
column.description: FK tlgnc_shippingpoint. The default shippingpoint when creating a new order.

column.name: LOADINGPOINT_ID
column.description: FK tlgnc_loadingpoint. The default loadingpoint when creating a new order.

column.name: QUANTITY
column.description: The default quantity of UOM_CD when an order is created based on this restriction. If the UOM has CREATE_MULTI_ORDER_FLAG=1 several orders will be created if >1

column.name: UOM_CD
column.description: FK tlgnr_uom_bs. The unit of measurement. This is the default for ordered_uom_cd when taking an order based on this restriction.

column.name: PER_SDORDER_QUANTITY
column.description: Default value for tlgnc_custorder_item.per_sdorder_quantity, which determines the planned quantity per Single Delivery Order later on. Value is taken from an enabled vehicle type with highest priority. If no priority is given, take the max net weight/volume of the available truck types.

column.name: PER_SDORDER_UOM_CD
column.description: FK tlgnr_uom_bs. Default value for tlgnc_custorder_item.per_sdorder_uom_cd, which is the relates unit of measure of per_sdorder_quantity.

column.name: EXACT_CUSTORDER_QTY_FLAG
column.description: Default value for tlgnc_custorder_item.exact_custorder_quantity_flag, which will have an effect on the creation of related single delivery orders. If true then last single delivery will be dynamically adjusted to reach total customer order item quantity exactly. If false then when the last Single Delivery Order is delivered the Customer Order is completed (as in LOGON 2.0).

column.name: EXACT_SDORDER_QTY_FLAG
column.description: Default value for tlgnc_custorder_item.exact_sdorder_quantity_flag, which has an effect on single delivery quantities and is used together with the value of per_sdorder_quantity field.

column.name: ON_HOLD_ORDER_AND_LOCKED_FLAG
column.description: 1=true, if order is a so-called on-hold order and currently 'locked' (German: 'Abrufauftrag'), 0=normal order, or an on-hold order which was unlocked. When set for Truck orders: can be processed until status '6=Dispatched'. When set for Rail orders: can not be transmitted to rail company (but loading/dispatching possible). After those states/actions, the flag is readonly and can not be set again. If true order can be deleted even in status dispatched.

column.name: OPEN_CUSTORDER_FLAG
column.description: Default value for tlgnc_custorder.open_custorder_flag. If this flag is set then a Single Delivery Order will be created in the first step but when that order is loaded (end loading event) a new Single Delivery Order will be created, schedule and released (if the 'Autom. Release' is checked). This process will be repeated until the Customer Order is manually closed (in order details pop-up or via weighing system interface).

column.name: DELIVERY_FREQ_EVERY_TIME
column.description: Default value for tlgnc_custorder.delivery_freq_every_time. If specified the customer order is supposed to be sliced into sequential Single Delivery Orders with the time difference defined here.

column.name: DELIVERY_FREQ_EVERY_TIME_UOM
column.description: Default value for tlgnc_custorder.delivery_freq_every_time_uom.Unit of measure of DELIVERY_FQ_EVERY_TIME_UNIT. HRE = hour, MIN = minute, other units are not supported at the moment.

column.name: DELIVERY_FREQ_QTYPERHRE
column.description: Default value for tlgnc_custorder.delivery_freq_qtyperhre. If specified the customer order is supposed to be sliced into Single Delivery Orders so that the specified amount of material is delivered per hour. Also known as performance order.

column.name: DELIVERY_FREQ_QTYPERHRE_UOM_CD
column.description: FK tlgnr_uom_bs. Default value for tlgnc_custorder.delivery_freq_qtyperhre_uom. Unit of measure of DELIVERY_FREQ_QTYPERHRE.

column.name: DELIVERY_TIME_TOLERANCE
column.description: Default value for tlgnc_custorder.delivery_time_tolerance. Defines the delivery time window around the planned delivery time of the Single Delivery Order.

column.name: DELIVERY_TIME_TOLERANCE_UOM
column.description: Default value for tlgnc_custorder.delivery_time_tolerance_uom. Unit of measure of DELIVERY_TIME_TOLERANCE. HRE = hour, MIN = minute, other units are not supported at the moment.

column.name: DELIVERY_TYPE_CD
column.description: FK tlgnr_delivery_type_bs. Delivery type (Lieferart), e.g LKW direkt, Bahn direkt, Bahn-LKW. This is the default for tlgnc_order.delivery_type_cd when taking an order based on this restriction.

column.name: POOL_ID
column.description: FK tlgnc_pool. The default pool when creating a new order.

column.name: AUTO_POOL_ASSIGNMENT_FLAG
column.description: If set, a new order is automatically assigned to the pool defined by pool_id.

column.name: AUTO_RELEASE_FLAG
column.description: If set, a new order is automatically assigned to the planning truck of the defined commercial carrier, or the first planning truck of the generic carrier and thus it's immediately transmitted to LDS.

column.name: COMM_CARRIER_ID
column.description: FK tlgnc_carrier. The default commercial carrier when creating a new order. For rail orders also the default executing carrier.

column.name: AUTO_CARRIER_ASSIGNMENT_FLAG
column.description: If set, a new order is automatically assigned to the carrier defined by comm_carrier_id.

column.name: EXEC_CARRIER_ID
column.description: FK tlgnc_carrier. The default executing carrier when creating a new order.

column.name: BILLTO_SAP_BP_ID
column.description: FK tlgns_sap_bp. The default fix billto (Rechnungsempfaenger, Haendler), always wins against the billto rules (see billto_rule_type_cd). If null, free_delivery_flag=0 and billto_ruletype_cd is null: no default billto is set.

column.name: PAYER_SAP_BP_ID
column.description: FK tlgns_sap_bp. The default fix payer (Rechnungszahler). Can be set independently to billto_sap_bp_id and free_delivery_flag. If null: No default payer is set.

column.name: BILLTO_RULETYPE_CD
column.description: FK tlgnr_billto_ruletype_cd. If set, a so called billto-rhythm is active (instead of a single default billto). See tlgnc_shipto_sarea_restr_btrul, where the actual rules are stored.

column.name: FREE_DELIVERY_FLAG
column.description: Controls whether free of charge is the DEFAULT for orders based on this shipto/restriction. Flag can only be set if tlgnc_shipto_sarea.free_delivery_flag = 1.

column.name: RELEASE_SAP_FLAG
column.description: If 0: an order containing this product will get tlgnc_order.release_sap_flag=0 as DEFAULT and therefore not be sent to SAP immediately when completed. Flag can only be set if tlgnc_shipto_sarea.release_sap_optional_flag = 1.

column.name: SAP_SUPPRESS_MIN_CHARGE_FLAG
column.description: Default value for tlgnc_custorder.sap_suppress_min_charge_flag. In SAP the customer has to pay a special charge/penalty if he orders a quantity below a defined quantity. Goal is to reduce deliveries which do not utilize the truck fully. Example: if a customer would order only 5 tons then he has to pay transport costs as if the truck had delivered 20 tons plus 5 tons material costs plus penality. All those cost calculations are done in SAP. LOGON has only the possiblity to provide a flag as indication that NO penality has to be invoiced by SAP.

column.name: NOTE_ORDER_MGMT
column.description: Notes of the order management about the product. Will become value of tlgnc_order_item.item_note_order_mgmt, not modifiable there by a Call Center Agent.

column.name: NOTE_DELIVERY
column.description: Additional text for the delivery note about the product. Will become initial value of tlgnc_order_item.item_note_delivery.

column.name: NOTE_DISPATCHING
column.description: Notes for the Pool/Carrier about the product. Will become initial value of tlgnc_order_item.item_note_dispatching.

column.name: NOTE_TRUCK_DRIVER
column.description: Notes for the Driver about the product. Will become initial value of tlgnc_order_item.item_note_truck_driver.

column.name: NOTE_RAILWAY_DISP
column.description: Notes for the Railway disposition about the product. Will become initial value of tlgnc_order_item.item_note_railway.

column.name: PACKAGE_TYPE_CD
column.description: FK tlgnr_package_type_bs. Package type: Bulk or Bag.

column.name: SAP_CONTRACT_ITEM_ID
column.description: FK tlgns_sap_contract_item_id. Reference to the contract-item on which this restriction is based.Multiple restrictions can belong to the same contract item (see generic materials). However, services and possibly other special materials can be contained in an order even when not contained in a contract. For these items: Field is null. The contract is supposed to count as a base when creating restrictions, but the restriction setting can be changed later on. Even if field is set, the usage of this restriction is NOT limited to that contrac, but for all identical materials even from other contracts as long as the order taking validation rules.

column.name: SPI_CD
column.description: The keycd of the special processing indicator reference record.
